levels.name: Executes
levels.detail: Performs the work as designed by others: runs the checks, follows the procedure, completes the audit.

levels.name: Maintains
levels.short: Owns and runs an existing program
levels.detail: Keeps an existing program or process running and compliant, trains others in it, handles routine issues.

levels.name: Builds
levels.detail: Creates a program, process or system that didn't exist, or rebuilds one from the ground up.

levels.name: Improves
levels.short: Diagnoses with data and measurably improves
levels.detail: Finds root causes, evaluates what's working with evidence, and changes systems with measurable results.

levels.name: Leads
levels.short: Sets direction and is trusted when it matters most
levels.detail: Shapes approach across teams or sites, is brought in for crises and novel problems, and holds others accountable for results.

demonstrated.label: Demonstrated
demonstrated.detail: A specific example with actions and outcomes, ideally measured

described.label: Described
described.detail: Stated as a responsibility, without a concrete outcome

inferred.label: Inferred
inferred.detail: Implied by job titles, skills or education only

story_prompts.title: A failure you investigated
story_prompts.hint: A defect, incident, complaint or outage: how you found the root cause and what you changed so it didn't recur.

story_prompts.title: A risk you caught early
story_prompts.hint: A hazard or weakness you identified before it became a problem, and how you assessed and controlled it.

story_prompts.title: An emergency you handled
story_prompts.hint: A recall, crisis, outage or urgent escalation: your role, the decisions you made, and how it ended.

story_prompts.title: A system you built or fixed
story_prompts.hint: A program, process or tool you designed or rebuilt, and how you proved it worked.

story_prompts.title: Data that changed an operation
story_prompts.hint: Analysis or trending you did that led to a real operational change, with the before and after.

story_prompts.title: Holding others accountable
story_prompts.hint: Getting a team, supplier or leadership to own a problem and deliver results.
